notices.support: Heading "NOTICE TO OWNER" then three capitals sentences, quoted in full below.
notices.summary_row: NOTICE TO OWNER (lien disclosure), before any payment
notices.end: PAYING FOR LABOR AND MATERIAL TWICE.
notices.quote_note: None: the notice is not in quotation marks. It is the heading NOTICE TO OWNER and the capitals paragraph that follows 'shall include the following disclosure language in ten-point bold type:'; the cut ends at the end of that paragraph, before subsection 2. The word "LIEN WAIVERS" carries the statute's own quotation marks inside the notice and is included.
notices.boundary_unsure: None on the edges: the notice is set off as its own lines after the colon, and subsection 2 starts on the next line. Applies to every contract (original contractor, before payment); the 429.012(4) exemption for new residences with title insurance cannot be decided by the builder.

notices.format: One statement headed NOTICE OF CANCELLATION in 10-point boldface with the date of the transaction and the seller's name and mailing address; no duplicate tear-off form
notices.support: 407.710 is one statement headed "NOTICE OF CANCELLATION", with a line for the date and for the seller's name and mailing address; there is no duplicate tear-off form in the Missouri statute.
notices.hold_reason: the 407.710(2) statement is not cleanly delimited: only the heading "NOTICE OF CANCELLATION" is in quotation marks, the Revisor extraction inserts a stray "; and" and instruction lines ("Date of transaction must be filled in at time of sale by seller") between the heading and the paragraph, and subsection (2) offers the federal form instead; also credit sales only, which the builder cannot tell

notices.title: CONSENT OF OWNER (lets subcontractors and suppliers file mechanic's liens)
notices.trigger: Repair, remodeling or addition on owner-occupied residential property of four units or less, if the contractor wants its subcontractors and suppliers to have lien rights
notices.format: Ten point bold type, signed separately from the 429.012 notice
notices.support: which "shall be printed in ten point bold type and signed separately from the notice required by section 429.012"
notices.summary_row: CONSENT OF OWNER (owner-occupied residential, four units or less; optional block that lets subs and suppliers lien)
notices.quote_note: None: not in quotation marks. Starts at the heading line after 'shall contain the following words:' and ends at the end of the capitals sentence, before subsection 3.
notices.boundary_unsure: None on the edges. Stored, not printed: optional for the contractor and only for owner-occupied residential property of four units or less.

notices.title: Notice of contractor's right to offer to cure construction defects

notices.format: Conspicuous capital-letter notice in substantially the statutory form; may be part of the contract; no type size stated
notices.support: The contractor shall provide notice to each homeowner upon entering into a contract for sale, construction, or substantial remodel of a residence
notices.summary_row: Notice of contractor's right to offer to cure (capitals notice; new construction or substantial remodel)
notices.block: RSMo 436.353: notice of offer to cure

notices.end: BEFORE YOU ARE ENTITLED TO FILE A LAWSUIT UNDER SECTIONS 436.350 TO 436.365.
notices.quote_note: None: not in quotation marks. Starts at the capitals paragraph after 'shall be in substantially the following form:' and ends at its last sentence, before subsection 3.

changes.support: the term "business day" shall mean any day except Saturday, Sunday, and legal holidays.

changes.new: Under the Missouri act a business day is any day except Saturday, Sunday and legal holidays; the federal rule still counts Saturday.
changes.support: Saturday does not count under the Missouri act (it does under the federal rule).

unsure: MO-lien: the NOTICE TO OWNER is now cut out of the 429.012 block and printed in every contract; the new-residence title-insurance exemption in 429.012(4) cannot be decided by the builder.
MO-cancel-credit: held; the 407.710(2) statement is not cleanly delimited (stray '; and' and instruction lines) and applies only to credit sales, so it must never be printed as it stands.
MO-consent: cut out and stored on file only; the statute makes it a contractor's choice, not a duty, so it is not printed.
MO-cure: cut out and stored on file only; it applies only to new construction or a remodel costing over half the assessed value, which the builder cannot tell.
cancellation.no_work_or_payment_in_window: left false because the file says only that the seller gets no pay for services done before cancellation, not that work is barred.
